state.scenario: A runaway trolley is heading down a track toward five people who cannot get off the track in time and will be killed. You are standing next to a lever. If you pull it, the trolley switches to a side track, where it will kill one person who cannot get off that track. If you do nothing, the five die. There is no other option.

criteria.pull_lever: pull the lever, so one person dies and five live
criteria.do_nothing: do nothing, so five people die and one lives

pulling_is_permissible.instructions: Is it morally permissible to pull the lever in `scenario`?
